adoption_fraction.source: Fictional full adoption of the stated eligible document volume; not an observed rate.

attempts_per_task.source: Fictional one billable generation attempt per assisted document; replace with metered attempts.

generation_cash_per_attempt.source: Fictional service-cost range; not a provider quote or price.

integration_hours.source: Fictional initial integration and training effort, excluded from document event ledgers.

setup_cash.source: Fictional external setup cost, excluding already valued integration labor.

support_hours.source: Fictional shared operating support; excludes document checking and repair.

maintenance_hours.source: Fictional workflow upkeep; excludes MAINTENANCE_EDIT already charged per document.

platform_cash.source: Fictional recurring platform cost, excluding generation cost; not a price quote.

cash_conversion_fraction.source: No mechanism for converting staff capacity into changed payroll or contractor cash was supplied.
